content.title: User-centered augmented reality design of BaDuanjin exercise: integrating Kano model and strategic experiential modules (SEMs)
content.abstract: This study examines the user-centered design of an augmented reality (AR) BaDuanjin application by combining the Kano model with Strategic Experiential Modules (SEMs). Employing a mixed-methods approach—comprising expert interviews, focus group discussions, and quantitative Kano-informed requirement analysis—the research identifies and categorizes user needs into must-be, one-dimensional, attractive, and indifferent attributes.
